title: Treasury Analyst
description:
About Credix


Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America.

We originate more than R$700M per year in B2B credit to Brazilian SMEs through CrediPay, our embedded finance platform. We operate in a segment where traditional financial infrastructure is limited, building proprietary credit intelligence and risk frameworks that do not yet exist in this market.

By combining structured capital markets solutions with real-time credit decisioning, we enable marketplaces and suppliers to offer seamless payment terms to their buyers, while we manage risk, pricing, and capital efficiency behind the scenes.

We are not a traditional lender. We are building the risk engine that powers scalable B2B commerce in Brazil.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job

As our Treasury Analyst you will be the financial engine behind Credix's growth. You will ensure disciplined cash management, optimal allocation of treasury capital, and robust operational support for the FIDC — making treasury a zero-surprise, high-performance function. Beyond operations, you will play a strategic role in enabling new financial products by providing the close monitoring of disbursements and collateral management that these products demand, while co-owning the definition of Credix's SEC liquidity policy. You will report to the Head of Finance.


Qualifications

  • Treasury & Investment Management: Ability to assess and execute short-to-medium term investments across fixed income instruments, optimising for yield within defined risk limits.
  • Cash Flow Modelling: Strong spreadsheet skills for building and maintaining multi-scenario short-term cash forecasts.
  • FIDC Mechanics: Deep understanding of FIDC capital structure, capital calling processes, bordero flows, and settlement reconciliation.
  • Collateral Management: Familiarity with collateral monitoring frameworks, margin calls, and eligibility criteria for structured credit products.
  • Brazilian Payment Infrastructure: Solid understanding of domestic payment rails (TED, PIX, boleto) and settlement flows in a regulated financial environment.
  • Disbursements Monitoring: Ability to track and analyse disbursement flows, identify bottlenecks, and escalate proactively.
  • Excel / Google Sheets at advanced level;
    SQL is a plus.
  • Precision Under Pressure: Zero tolerance for errors in transfers and reconciliations;
    thrives in a structureddaily ops rhythm.
  • Structured Communication: Clear escalation instincts — you know what to resolve independently and what requires immediate alignment with leadership.
  • Process Builder: Actively documents recurring processes and builds runbooks so that nothing lives only in someone's head.
  • Intellectual Curiosity: Proactively seeks to understand the financial and structural rationale behind each treasury and capital markets flow.
  • Ownership: Treats treasury as a product to be continuously improved, not a task list to be cleared.
  • Strategic Mindset: Sees beyond daily operations to understand how treasury efficiency directly drives business growth.
  • Cross-Functional: Comfortable operating at the intersection of Engineering, Capital Markets, Risk, and GTM.


Responsibilities

  • Optimal Treasury Allocation: Actively manage Credix's treasury to maximise risk-adjusted yield, balancing liquidity needs against investment opportunities within approved parameters.
  • Cash Visibility: Maintain accurate short-term cash forecasting (daily/weekly) so the business never faces a liquidity surprise.
  • FIDC Capital Efficiency: Execute timely capital calls and monitor FIDC capacity to ensure disbursements are never blocked by capital constraints.
  • New Product Enablement: Provide the disbursement monitoring and collateral management framework required to safely launch and scale new financial products.
  • SEC Liquidity Policy: Co-define the normalised liquidity buffer policy for the SEC and monitor compliance on an ongoing basis.
  • Seller Onboarding Support: Prepare financial materials and treasury inputs required for onboarding new sellers across capital markets workflows.
  • Reconciliation Integrity: Own weekly cash reconciliation across all accounts and FIDC positions with zero tolerance for unexplained variances.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

Na Inmetrics, transformamos estratégia em resultado.

ATENÇÃO: A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Contract Manager para realizar a gestão estratégica de um portfólio de contratos pertencentes a um ou mais Projetos de Capital da empresa, dentro da Vice-Presidência de Engenharia. A atuação se dará durante todo o ciclo de vida do contrato, atuando nos seguintes pilares:


  • Gerenciamento de riscos contratuais e de projetos;
  • Gestão de alterações contratuais (análise de mérito e valor para change order, Claim, back charge);
  • Gestão de conflitos (negociações, análise de cenários para tomada de decisão);
  • Gestão de registros;
  • Gestão das relações com as partes interessadas (internas e externas).


No setor de Engenharia, essa posição irá atuar na equipe do projeto, reportando-se aos Project Managers, atuando de maneira transversal entre as disciplinas nos projetos, com reporte duplo à Gerência Corporativa de Contratos e Riscos. A função atuará de forma integrativa, garantindo comunicação fluida e tomadas de decisão de forma multidisciplinar.

Objetivo estratégico: melhorar a previsibilidade e assertividade dos resultados dos projetos em questão, através da prevenção de desvios contratuais e predição das tendências identificadas na gestão de riscos.



Responsabilidades:


  • Monitoramento e controle dos indicadores contratuais a nível contrato e projeto;
  • Gestão/mediaçãode negociações e conflitos;
  • Zelar pelo cumprimento da governança e procedimentos de gestão de contratos e riscos;
  • Realizar reporting executivo em frequência adequada (indicadores, status de conflitos sob gestão da área, negociações pré-contratação, tendências identificadas em fase de implantação, etc).
  • Gestão de registros realizados através de instrumentos contratuais e de comunicação (RDO, atas, cartas, e-mails, relatórios), realizando análise dos registros, definição de respostas e casos prioritários.
  • Gestão de escopo, identificando potenciais desvios (técnicos ou contratuais), monitorando prazos, obrigações e responsabilidades das partes do contrato.



Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração ou afins;
  • Experiência sólida em gestão/administração de contratos e negociação;
  • Conhecimento e/ou experiências em gestão de riscos contratuais;
  • Habilidade de liderança, visão sistêmica, capacidade de comunicação com diferentes níveis, criação de sinergia entre grupos de trabalho.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no Rio de Janeiro


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento e/ou experiência envolvendo: gestão de disputas, arbitragens e/ou de projetos, formação de preço/orçamento, planejamento, gestão de custos;
  • Pós-graduação ou certificações em gestão de projetos (PMP, RMP, IPMA, CCM, etc.);

  • Vivência em ambientes com cultura Lean e foco em melhoria contínua.

Na AXIA Energia, o bem-estar e a qualidade de vida das nossas pessoas impulsionam a energia que nos move. description:
Netcracker Shaping the Digital Future

As a proud subsidiary of NEC Corporation, Netcracker is a global software leader driving innovation at scale. Join us and be part of a team that is not just keeping up with the digital future—we’re leading it.


About the role

The Finance Project Analyst will oversee financial performance for assigned projects, focusing on key metrics like budget consumption, invoicing, and cash flow. The role also involves managing vendor contracts, ensuring operational compliance, and escalating financial concerns. Additionally, the analyst will optimize processes, track project health, and assist with forecast, invoicing and payments.


Role & Responsibilities

  • Act as a key contact for interpreting and investigating financial results for assigned projects
  • Prepare, reconcile, analyze, and report project KPIs
  • Review actual and planned resources, flag discrepancies to Project Managers
  • Handle project closeout reconciliations and escalate issues as needed
  • Analyze financial and business data for assigned projects and contracts
  • Coordinate with Project Managers on change orders, project status, resourcing, and budgets
  • Assist in developing regular financial status reports for projects
  • Record monthly revenue for contracts and communicate estimates to clients
  • Monitor subcontractor and vendor contracts, acting as the contact point for external/internal resources
  • Attend project meetings to support Project Managers and ensure accurate forecasting
  • Track overall project health, including revenues, gross profit, receivables, and project closeouts
  • Ensure that operational procedures are being followed by Project Teams
  • Identify and work with team leads to resolve and/or escalate violations as needed
  • Validate reports obtained from projects and ensure that the reports are provided on time
  • Work with project team leads and program directors on operational support needs, set up and lead project meetings
  • Assist with Resource plan baselines
  • Review and manage exceptions and escalate to stakeholders as needed
  • Process and distribute reports, defining tool requirements
  • Analyze and monitor dashboard reports on every project created monthly
  • Identify planned projects monthly
  • Identify projects with Level of Effort (LOE) overage and escalate these to senior management
  • Schedule invoices and assist in their payment
  • Work with management to optimize processes


Required Experience

  • 3 or more years experience working in financial analysis
  • Self-motivated with a strong work ethic and the ability to work independently
  • Able to work well with others
  • Able to use discretion while dealing with confidential matters
  • Able to pay close attention to detail
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Knowledge of Project Management Standard and Great Plains system.
  • Prior experience in project analysis and ASC 606 revenue recognition strongly preferred
  • Prior experience in portfolio financial management and forecasting strongly preferred
  • Significant past experience in an administrative position with responsibility for audit and processing tasks
  • Ability to follow business rules and procedures while analyzing and identifying errors in processes and data
  • Really good attention to detail
  • Fluent English speaker
  • Availability to work from office in hybrid mode


Education

  • BSC in Accounting/Finance, or related field

title: Analista De Compliance Sênior
description:

Através das nossas duas marcas, Copagaz e Liquigás, respondemos por 25% da distribuição de Gás Liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP) do Brasil. Possuímos operações em 25 estados e Distrito Federal e cerca de 90 mil colaboradores diretos e indiretos. Sendo a maior empresa no segmento de GLP da América Latina. Responsabilidades e atribuições

Requisitos e qualificações

Desejável:

  • Licença maternidade estendida de 180 (cento e oitenta dias) para você cuidar da pessoa mais importante da sua vida!

A Copa Energia valoriza a vida por meio da segurança e do respeito com as pessoas e com o meio ambiente. Tratamos as pessoas como gostaríamos de ser tratados. É assim que construímos um ambiente íntegro, diverso e inclusivo.


Por aqui, acreditamos que um ambiente plural é fundamental para o crescimento da Copa Energia e da nossa sociedade como um todo. Por isso, nossas oportunidades são abertas para todas as pessoas, independente da origem, gênero, cor, deficiência, orientação sexual ou crenças.


Venha energizar vidas com a gente!

title: Analista De Compras Sênior

title: Remote Kotlin / Java Backend Developer
description:
At Scanz, we are on a mission to bring magic back to trading software - specifically for active traders (aka day traders). To empower traders to do their best trading, we are building a next-generation Trader Analytics Platform that combines UI elegance with world-class real time performance. Founded in 2004, Scanz has become the platform of choice for 40,000+ traders to identify, plan and make their trades.


Scanz is a fully remote company. Today, our small but mighty team is distributed across North America, South America, Europe and Australia. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and our passion for software craftsmanship. We care deeply about the quality of our work.


As a very small team, we’re all generalists and constantly picking up new challenges. When it comes to code, we’re looking to work with experienced people who can pick a problem and solve it. We use Kotlin, TypeScript and React to build a highly-scalable system so we can continuously make progress on a solid foundation. We don’t expect you to have a background in everything we use, but we do expect strong Java fundamentals (Kotlin even better) and a background working with React and TypeScript.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement server-side logic using Spring Webflux and Kotlin.
  • Build robust, reliable, fault-tolerant data pipelines that process millions of operations daily.
  • Collaborate with front-end developers to integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic.
  • Develop and maintain APIs, ensuring high performance and responsiveness.
  • Contribute to database design and implementation (PostgreSQL).
  • Improve the system's throughput and incorporate performance testing into our CI pipelines.
  • Scale services horizontally.
  • Contribute to weekly standup.


Requirements

  • Strong proficiency in Kotlin / Java.
  • Proficiency with Kotlin coroutines (flows).
  • Proficiency with Spring Webflux and Reactive Streams back pressure.
  • Self-motivated developer comfortable working as a core member on an A-list team of backend and frontend developers split over different time zones.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills within an asynchronous environment (Slack, Loom).
  • Deep-level understanding of distributed systems and how to make fault-tolerant applications.
  • Experience with containerization technologies (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Strong familiarity with database systems, particularly PostgreSQL.
  • Comfortable using AWS and cloud computing platforms.
  • Solid understanding of the testing pyramid, specifically unit, integration, and E2E tests.
  • Readiness and desire to participate in code reviews.
  • We're hiring across Americas and European time zones


Tech Stack

Back End

  • Kotlin
  • Spring Webflux
  • Ktor Server
  • Kotlin Coroutines
  • RSocket
  • Ktor Client
  • Kotlinx Serialization
  • Quartz
  • Kotest + JUnit
  • Gradle


Front End

  • Kotlin Multiplatform
  • React (with hooks)
  • SharedWorker
  • TypeScript
  • NPM
  • Gradle


Infrastructure

  • AWS + S3
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • Jenkins
  • Github

Highlights :

Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Job Description

The LATAM D2C Team is responsible for the sales growth of eCommerce DtC Channels (Samsung.Com, B2B2C, B2B and Omni Channel) working in partnership with the 7 subsidiaries in Latin America.

As we expand our operations in the region, we are looking for a D2C New Business & Sales Projects Manager.

Together with Samsung subsidiaries (LATAM), the role will be responsible for the development, sales and overall performance of the main D2C sales programs and new business projects, leading the following pillars/strategic areas:

- D2C Sell-out Platforms Management: Strengthen LATAM D2C exclusive programs (such as: Trade-in, Co-Branded Card, Extended Warranty, Installation Service), enabling the sales growth and targets achievement.

- New Business Projects: Define innovative programs based on sell-out platforms such as subscription models and value-added services and draw the commercial strategies to execute and grow them.

- D2C Partnerships: Responsible for stablishing and managing new partners for LATAM D2C, aiming to create opportunities of customer acquisition, traffic increase and co-investments for sales conversion.

- Sales Operations: Promote eStore capabilities and coordinate key initiatives along with internal platform/product teams or external partners, aiming to achieve D2C main targets.

- CRP: Customer Retention Program ambassador in LATAM D2C, engaging all subsidiary in the company’s strategy and promoting the alignment and projects execution with CS and related stakeholders.

Key Job Responsabilities

  • Define, track, report and engage subs to implement the regional/global Sell-out enablers strategy, and ensure the main KPIs achievement.
  • Define the sell-out programs sales strategy by working with the business areas to implement the promotional and forecast plan.
  • Ensure the sell-out programs’ financial sustainability while balancing an attractive promotional agenda with business profitability.
  • Support in marketing / UX strategies for the sell-out enablers launch and enhancement, ensuring the correct communication and display of programs for brand consumers;
  • Act as a PMO ofregional projects that focus on accelerating D2C performance;
  • Together with Samsung subsidiaries in LATAM, act in the management of partnerships that make up the digital online channel ecosystem.
  • Prospect regional partnerships and co-lead the deployment of those along with the subsidiaries, focusing on the continuous creation of new business and co-investment opportunities.
  • In conjunction with the IT team, manage the D2C sell-out projects roadmap, responding by the business assessment, development, execution, GTM and usability of the tools.
  • Manage the continuous improvement agenda of the D2C programs, focusing on user experience and increasing of conversion.
  • Integration with CS Team and related areas to promote CRP (Customer Retention Program) agenda in D2C LATAM, engaging eStore Business and Commercial teams to implement the regional strategy.
  • Executive report on sell-out programs strategies and business results.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration or other relevant areas.
  • Experience in new business and projects department.
  • Management/operation of e-commerce platforms.
  • Strong skills in communication and project management.
  • Master presentation and report skills, structured by deep data analysis.
  • Ease in dealing with complex database, SQL queries, VBA and Excel program.
  • Advanced English skills, Spanish will be considered a plus.


Why is Samsung Electronics the place to be?

Join a Global Team : Work with a dynamic and diverse team, constantly interacting with different cultures.

Tackle Big Challenges : Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

Shape the Future : Collaborate in an open, innovative environment where your ideas come to life, creating products that redefine the future.

Make an Impact : Contribute to groundbreaking technologies that improve lives and support communities worldwide. At Samsung, your work truly makes a difference.


Benefits :

  • Comprehensive health and wellness programs

  • Global networking and collaboration



At Samsung, we want you to be yourself! We prioritize fairness and will never request personal information unrelated to the selection process, such as marital status, age, gender, religion, or political opinions.

  • A Tractebel é mais do que um local de trabalho. É a sua oportunidade de evoluir ao lado de especialistas em projetos com impacto global .   • Para celebrarmos momentos especiais e simplesmente nos divertirmos, realizamos ações em datas comemorativas, presenteamos você no seu aniversário, festejamos juntos em nossa confraternização de fim de ano e muito mais.

Como Analista de Planejamento da área de Power, você contribuirá para a nossa missão de construirmos juntos um futuro neutro em carbono todos os dias.

  • Suporte ao processo de emissão de ARTs (Anotação de Responsabilidade Técnica) e ACTs (Atestado de Capacidade Técnica);
  • Condução do processo de encerramento de projetos;
  • Contribuição para a implementação e a correta utilização das ferramentas de Gestão de Projetos e Tramitação de documentos (GED);
  • Apoio à definição de padrões e procedimentos de gestão e na disseminação dos conceitos de governança em gerenciamento de projetos para as equipes;
  • Apoio ao desenvolvimento e implementação de procedimentos para melhoria dos processos em Gestão de Projetos.


COMPETÊNCIAS NECESSÁRIAS:

  • Experiência prévia na área de planejamento e controle de projetos será um diferencial;

FORMAÇÃO

OUTRAS INFORMAÇÕES:

As nossas prioridades são as pessoas, a ética, a segurança e a sustentabilidade. Com a Tractebel, você pode ter um impacto positivo nos objetivos globais de neutralizar as emissões de carbono. O nosso maior ativo são os nossos empregados e a diversidade é a nossa força!


Saiba mais sobre a Tractebel , as nossas atividades e o porquê de se deve juntar a nós!


Na ENGIE, todo talento tem um papel a desempenhar na aceleração da transição energética. Faça a diferença e desfrute de uma experiência profissional gratificante. Encare desafios empolgantes e construa uma trajetória de carreira que reflita quem você é.


Junte-se a nós e faça parte da aventura do século!

title: Senior Payments Manager – Brazil
description:
Brazil's payment landscape is complex, fast-moving, and full of opportunity and Antom is building the infrastructure to lead it. We're looking for a Senior Payments Manager who thrives at the intersection of relationship management and operational excellence: someone who can navigate Brazil's financial ecosystem with depth and turn strong partnerships into real payment performance.


What you'll do:


Financial institution & payment partner management

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for Antom's local payment partners in Brazil, including PIX providers, card acquirers, and Open Finance participants.
  • Maintain and deepen these partnerships to ensure reliability, competitive terms, and long-term strategic alignment.


Payment performance & operations

  • In close collaboration with Antom's internal operations team, monitor and improve SLAs, success rates, and KPIs across local payment methods.
  • Identify performance gaps, coordinate resolution efforts with partners, and drive continuous improvement in payment reliability and conversion.


New payment method onboarding

  • Scout, evaluate, and onboard new local payment methods and financial institution partners that expand Antom's capabilities in Brazil.
  • Lead the end-to-end process from commercial negotiation through to technical go-live.


Cross-functional collaboration

  • Act as Antom's internal Brazil payments subject-matter expert, aligning with Product, Tech, Compliance, and Legal teams to ensure local solutions are properly integrated and optimized.


Regulatory awareness

  • Stay ahead of Banco Central regulations, PIX rulebook updates, Open Finance developments, and card scheme rules.
  • Translate regulatory changes into actionable internal recommendations and partner discussions.


Market intelligence

  • Continuously map the Brazilian payments landscape — tracking competitor capabilities, emerging payment trends, and new fintech entrants to inform Antom's local strategy.


What we're looking for

  • 5–8 years in payments, financial institutions partnerships, or payment operations within a fintech, bank, acquirer, payment processor, or global payments company — with a strong focus on the Brazilian market.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of Brazil's payment ecosystem: PIX, card acquiring, and Open Finance, including its regulatory framework and key institutional players.
  • Proven relationship management skills — ability to build and manage senior-level relationships with banks, acquirers, and payment institutions, including navigating complex contractual and operational discussions.
  • Operational mindset — comfortable owning KPIs and SLAs, troubleshooting payment issues with technical and partner teams, and driving measurable performance improvements.
  • Cross-functional communication — able to work across commercial, product, tech, and compliance teams, translating between business needs and technical requirements with ease.
  • Languages: Native Portuguese and full professional English proficiency.


Preferred qualifications

  • Prior experience at a global payments company, international acquirer, or cross-border payment platform operating in Brazil.
  • Existing network across Brazilian financial institutions, acquirers, and Open Finance participants.
  • Familiarity with API-based payment integrations and the technical fundamentals of payment processing.

title: Almoxarife Junior

Principais atividades:

- Receber o fornecedor, o estoquista deve conferir os dados na nota fiscal para que se certificar que a entrega é referente ao pedido de compras.

- Atualizar o estoque no sistema com as quantidades e envie a nota ao comprador;

- Realizar as distribuições de insumos / bebidas conforme as solicitações de cada evento / espaço seguindo a requisição;

- Após fazer a distribuição solicitar o de acordo do responsável da cozinha / coordenador de eventos.

- Ter pelo menos ensino médio completo (desejável graduação)

Esta é uma posição "mão na massa", responsável por contas a pagar/receber, conciliações, suporte à administração de departamento pessoal/benefícios e rotinas gerais de escritório.


Rotinas Contábeis e Fiscais

  • Conciliar faturas de fornecedores, faturamento de clientes, faturas de cartão de crédito e relatórios de reembolso de despesas.
  • Manter registros financeiros precisos e documentação de suporte organizada.
  • Auxiliar nas conciliações bancárias e no suporte ao fechamento contábil mensal.
  • Apoiar a preparação de dados financeiros para relatórios e auditorias.
  • Auxiliar nas apurações de impostos e possuir conhecimento básico das obrigações acessórias (ECD, ECF, EFD ICMS/IPI, REINF).


Suporte a Departamento Pessoal e Benefícios

  • Apoiar o processamento da folha de pagamento em coordenação com a contabilidade externa.
  • Manter registros de funcionários, incluindo documentação de admissão e demissão.
  • Administrar benefícios, incluindo planos de saúde/seguro e vale-refeição/alimentação (cartão Caju).
  • Apoiar o acompanhamento de FGTS e 13º salário.
  • Garantir o controle preciso de saldos de férias e direitos trabalhistas.
  • Apoiar na documentação de saúde e segurança ocupacional (SST) e possuir conhecimento básico de e-Social e DCTFWeb.


Suporte Administrativo e de Escritório

  • Fornecer suporte geral à administração e coordenação do escritório.
  • Manter registros organizados de contratos, faturas e documentação de compliance.
  • Prestar suporte administrativo ao Líder de Finanças e à equipe do Brasil.
  • Apoiar na organização do escritório, recebimento de documentos, cadastro de visitantes/novos funcionários no condomínio e compra de materiais de escritório.


Requisitos e Experiência

  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis ou área correlata, com sólida experiência operacional.
  • Conhecimento das normas e rotinas contábeis brasileiras.
  • Domínio do Microsoft Excel.
  • Inglês em nível intermediário (escrita e leitura para comunicação interna).
  • Experiência prévia com sistemas ERP e provedores externos de folha de pagamento.


Como se candidatar

Somos um empregador que valoriza a igualdade de oportunidades e convidamos todos os profissionais qualificados a se candidatarem. Para participar do processo seletivo, inscreva-se através da página da Greenlane Renewables no LinkedIn e anexe seu currículo. Agradecemos o interesse de todos, porém apenas os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados.



Greenlane Renewables Inc., headquartered in metro Vancouver, Canada, is driving change: accelerating the energy transition. We are cleaning up two of the largest and most difficult-to-decarbonize sectors of the global energy system: the natural gas grid and commercial transportation. As a pioneer and leading global specialist in biogas desulfurization and upgrading, we have been actively contributing to the decarbonization of our planet for over 35 years with more than 500 systems supplied into 32 countries. Join us, let’s accelerate the energy transition together. Greenlane is a publicly-traded company on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: GRN).

title: Engenheiro De Homologação

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) Sênior de Homologação Regulatória, que atuará como elo estratégico entre produto, tecnologia e as regulamentações locais no Brasil.

Este(a) profissional será responsável por garantir que nossos veículos estejam plenamente em conformidade com as exigências regulatórias brasileiras, além de participar ativamente da definição da estratégia de localização de produtos, contribuindo de forma decisiva para o lançamento bem-sucedido e a competitividade contínua no mercado.

Responsabilidades:


-Gestão de projetos de homologação

Coordenar integralmente os projetos de homologação de veículos no Brasil, incluindo o planejamento e acompanhamento de testes, preparação e submissão de documentação técnica, bem como obtenção e manutenção de certificações.


-Interface com órgãos e auditorias

Atuar como representante técnico da empresa perante órgãos certificadores locais e junto ao time global de homologação, liderando interações, auditorias e respostas a questionamentos técnicos, garantindo a conformidade regulatória dos produtos.


-Monitoramento regulatório

Acompanhar e interpretar continuamente as atualizações de leis, normas e políticas no Brasil (como emissões, segurança e eficiência energética), assegurando a comunicação eficaz dessas mudanças para as equipes globais de P&D.


-Suporte técnico e colaboração

Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes globais de engenharia, contribuindo com visão regulatória para adaptação local de produtos, otimização técnica e desenvolvimento.


Requisitos obrigatórios:


  • Graduação completa (ou superior) em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Automotiva, Engenharia Elétrica, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas


  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em homologação/regulamentação no setor automotivo


  • Sólido conhecimento da regulamentação brasileira CONAMA 492/2018 (Proconve L8) e dos processos de certificação veicular junto ao INMETRO, bem como entendimento das tendências futuras do Proconve L8


  • Conhecimento da arquitetura de veículos a combustão e híbridos, incluindo sistemas de powertrain

Diferenciais:

By joining our talented and dynamic team, you will contribute to a more sustainable, environment-friendly agriculture in an innovative scale-up at the cutting edge of technology. We are a revolutionary organization with a great work environment that supports creativity through self-motivation.


To pursue our growth in Brazil, we are hiring an experienced entrepreneurial mind based in Santa Catarina State for an:


Area Sales Manager


General objective of the role

As an Area Sales Manager of the Ecorobotix SA. Team, you will be responsible for managing and expanding the sales of agricultural machinery within a designated region. The role involves overseeing existing dealer relationships, optimizing dealer performance, and driving new business opportunities by identifying future dealers and customers as well as driving revenue growth. The Area Sales Manager will work closely with dealers to ensure product availability, support, and training, ensuring the company’s agricultural machinery is effectively marketed and sold. This position requires a leader with a deep understanding of market dynamics, strong leadership skills, and the ability to foster a results-oriented sales culture within the region.


Reporting lines and interactions

This role reports directly to the Commercial Director. Internally, you will closely collaborate with other members of the Sales team and other teams of Ecorobotix. Externally, you will interact with dealers, farmers, partners, associations, trade shows, Agronomists, and CCA’s.


A day in the life of an Area Sales Manager

The Area Sales Manager will travel across the designated territory to visit key accounts, meet new prospects, and support dealer partners. Whether you're pulling into a grower's yard or a dealership lot, you're the face of a cutting-edge ag-tech company that's reshaping the future of precision spraying.


You will showcase how our high-precision sprayer delivers real ROI: less chemical waste, more targeted application, and better yields. You walk growers through the technology— highlighting features like variable rate spraying and intelligent targeting—while grounding every conversation in real-world impact. You sit down and dig into the potential customer’s specific challenges and help them see how the product fits into their operation. You're not just selling equipment;
you're helping solve problems.


“You’re part field representative, part storyteller, part strategist. You’re a trusted advisor selling value, not just hardware.”


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and prospect new customers across Brazil, managing all communication and driving the sales process through to contract signature.
  • Engage with customers to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions, ensuring strong order generation and relationship development.
  • Assess customer solvency, share pricing information, negotiate terms, and suggest improvements to optimize pricing strategies.
  • Provide training and ongoing support to partners, while identifying opportunities for expanding and strengthening the partner network.
  • Actively participate in industry fairs, customer demos, and events to increase visibility and drive engagement in the region.
  • Foster collaboration and support within the distributor network to drive sales and enhance product reach.

Qualifications

Must-Have

description:
A Javali

A Javali é uma consultoria de marketing e desenvolvimento de negócios para escritórios de advocacia empresarial. Estamos no mercado há 14 anos e somos referência no setor: posicionamento, conteúdo, branding e geração de negócios para escritórios que atendem grandes empresas.

Somos um time pequeno, ágil e exigente. Buscamos pessoas que entregam, aprendem rápido e querem construir algo relevante. Aqui tem autonomia, ritmo e espaço real para crescer.


A vaga

Você será o ponto de contato principal entre a Javali e os clientes. Na prática, isso significa gerenciar uma carteira de escritórios de advocacia, conduzir reuniões, revisar entregas antes de enviar ao cliente, antecipar problemas e ter conversas difíceis quando necessário.

O advogado é um cliente exigente, argumentativo e com baixa tolerância a erro. Quem ocupa essa cadeira precisa ter postura para sustentar a relação: nem submisso, nem arrogante. Seguro, organizado e com capacidade de dizer não com elegância quando preciso.

Seu papel é garantir que o plano faça sentido, que o cliente esteja alinhado e que as entregas saiam com qualidade.


O que NÃO estamos buscando

  • Coordenador de projetos que organiza tarefas mas não fala com cliente. Aqui você é a cara da Javali para o escritório.
  • Atendimento de agência B2C que levava e trazia pedido de cliente pequeno. Nossos clientes são sócios de escritórios corporativos.
  • Profissional de CS/CX de SaaS. O relacionamento aqui é estratégico e consultivo, não é gestão de ticket.
  • Quem trava em conversa difícil. Se o cliente muda de ideia e cobra, você precisa sustentar a posição com firmeza e respeito.
  • Quem precisa de tudo mastigado para agir. O ambiente é dinâmico, as prioridades mudam, e você vai tomar decisões com informação incompleta.


Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar a carteira de clientes sob sua responsabilidade, garantindo alinhamento de expectativas, satisfação e renovação contratual.
  • Ser o principal ponto de contato entre cliente e Javali, representando a empresa com postura e segurança.

  • Ter conversas difíceis quando necessário: defender escopo, negociar prazos, realinhar expectativas, dizer não com elegância.

  • Construir briefings claros e estratégicos, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos do cliente.

  • Antecipar riscos de desgaste na conta, sugerindo correções de rota antes que virem problema.


Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiência prévia de no mínimo 3 anos em atendimento ou gestão de contas, preferencialmente em agências com foco em branding, conteúdo ou marketing B2B.
  • Domínio das principais práticas de marketing digital: branding, redes sociais, funil de conteúdo e campanhas.
  • Capacidade de construir e revisar briefings claros, estratégicos e orientados a resultado.
  • Senso estético e olhar crítico para validação de entregas visuais e textuais (posts, e-books, sites, apresentações).
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal, com domínio da norma culta e adaptação ao tom de cada cliente.
  • Conhecimento prático de ferramentas de gestão de tarefas e organização de backlog (Monday, Trello, Asana ou similares).
  • Capacidade de estruturar e apresentar relatórios executivos com clareza e embasamento.
  • Uso de inteligência artificial generativa (ChatGPT, Claude ou similar) com curiosidade e desenvoltura para otimizar tarefas.


Diferencial forte:

  • Familiaridade com o mercado jurídico: estrutura dos escritórios, áreas de atuação, perfil dos sócios.
  • Experiência com LinkedIn como plataforma estratégica para marcas e pessoas.
  • Experiência prévia com clientes corporativos exigentes (escritórios, bancos, consultorias, saúde corporativa).


Habilidades essenciais

  • Postura relacional com cliente sênior: capacidade de se impor com inteligência diante de sócios e lideranças, gerando respeito e confiança.
  • Capacidade de hard talk: conduzir conversas difíceis com cliente sem travar, sem levar pro pessoal e sem ser submisso.
  • Gestão de expectativa: antecipar problemas, comunicar com clareza, dizer não quando necessário.
  • Senso de dono: responsabilidade total pela qualidade da entrega e pela saúde da conta.
  • Organização e ritmo: gerenciar prazos, entregas e agendas com método e disciplina.
  • Autonomia: tomar decisões com informação incompleta, sem depender de microgestão.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos: manter clareza e eficiência com múltiplos clientes, mudanças rápidas e demandas simultâneas.

title: Accounting Analyst
description:

We are a consumer electronics trading company with operations that connect the Manaus technology manufacturing hub to the São Paulo retail market. We are looking for an analytical professional who understands that accounting goes beyond bookkeeping and is a strategic tool for decision-making.

  • Preferred Qualifications: Practical knowledge of the tax structure related to the Manaus Free Trade Zone and ICMS Substitution Tax in São Paulo.

Behavioral Profile:

  • Analytical and Critical Thinking: Ability to challenge numbers and identify root causes of variances.
  • Resilience: Ability to handle monthly closing deadlines.
  • Business Mindset: Understanding how accounting impacts the company’s cash flow.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary (Mid-level range).
  • Comprehensive benefits package (Meal/Food allowance, Medical Assistance, Life Insurance, Transportation allowance).
  • Work Model: On-site – Availability to work in the South Zone of São Paulo, near Shopping Morumbi.

Please send your updated resume to with the subject line: Accounting Analyst Position.

title: Billing Analyst
description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization.


Key Responsibilities

  • Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process.
  • Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures.
  • Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems.
  • Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability.
  • Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories.
  • Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs.
  • Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
  • Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
  • Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
  • Professional proficiency in English.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
  • Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
  • Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.
  • Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments.

- Health and Dental insurance.

title: Auditor Sênior
description:
Main responsibilities of the position:


Job Summary:


The Senior Auditor within Global Internal Audit (GIA) executes independent, objective assurance and advisory activities to assess the effectiveness of the Bank’s governance, risk management, and internal control processes. This hands‑on role supports audit engagements across all phases, including planning, risk assessment, fieldwork, reporting, and issue validation, and may lead assigned audit components or workstreams. The Senior Auditor is responsible for delivering assigned audit activities and documentation, identifying risks and control gaps, developing clear and actionable recommendations, and supporting the Audit In‑Charge (AIC) and Audit Manager with engagement execution, coordination, and stakeholder communication.


Major Responsibilities:


  • Execute risk‑based internal audit engagements in accordance with the IIA’s International Professional Practices Framework (IPPF), GIA Methodology, and applicable banking regulatory expectations.
  • Assess the design and operating effectiveness of governance, risk management, and internal control processes across banking products, operations, and support functions.
  • Apply professional skepticism and personal accountability to identify control weaknesses, assess root causes, and evaluate the impact on risk and risk management practices.
  • Generate insightful, well‑articulated audit observations that clearly convey significance, risk impact, and management implications, and report audit findings and issues to Audit Management.
  • Prepare and maintain high‑quality, stand‑alone audit documentation and workpapers that fully support audit conclusions and enable independent re‑performance.
  • Support the Audit In‑Charge (AIC) and Audit Manager with engagement execution, issue validation, and effective communication with management and key stakeholders.
  • Operate with an innovative and flexible mindset by continuously identifying opportunities to enhance audit consistency, efficiency, quality, and overall value.
  • Maintain effective working relationships with business, risk, and compliance partners while preserving independence and objectivity.


Desired experience for the role:


  • 4+ years of progressive experience in internal audit, external audit, risk management, or compliance, preferably within banking or financial services.
  • Experience executing risk‑based internal audit engagements end‑to‑end, including planning, fieldwork, reporting, and issue validation.
  • Hands‑on experience evaluating the design and operating effectiveness of internal controls across banking products, operations, and support functions.
  • Experience applying IIA IPPF standards and working within environments subject to banking regulatory oversight.
  • Experience producing stand‑alone audit documentation and workpapers that support conclusions and enable independent re‑performance.
  • Experience developing and reporting clear, risk‑focused audit observations that articulate significance, root cause, and impact on risk and risk management practices.


Specific knowledge, skills, and certifications required for the role:


  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills, required due to audit methodology, documentation, and regular interaction with global and local stakeholders conducted in English.
  • CIA preferred;
    CISA, CRMA, CRC, CPA-10, CPA-20 or equivalent professional certification is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of internal audit principles, risk‑based auditing, and internal control frameworks within a banking environment.
  • Ability to apply professional skepticism, sound judgment, and personal accountability when evaluating risks and controls.
  • Capability to develop clear, risk‑focused audit observations and communicate issues effectively to Audit Management and stakeholders.
  • Ability to prepare high‑quality, stand‑alone audit documentation that supports conclusions and enables independent re‑performance.
  • 'Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
  • Advanced degree (e.G., MBA or Master’s in Accounting/Finance) is a plus.

description:
Descrição da vaga

O Itaú é a marca mais valiosa do Brasil, a melhor empresa para trabalhar segundo o Great Place to Work e o maior banco da América Latina. Nós impactamos diariamente mais de 98 milhões de clientes em 18 países.

Nossa equipe de Arquitetura de Solução em IA é responsável por definir e acompanhar as frentes de Inteligência Artificial para padronizar uso de IA no Itaú. Cada solução é pensada para tornar as interações simples, rápidas e seguras, garantindo que as aplicações ofereçam fluidez e consistência. Trabalhamos para que a arquitetura, os Agentes e os serviços de IA habilitem jornadas generativas intuitivas, escaláveis e resilientes, conectando tecnologia e as necessidades para entregar valor real aos itubers e clientes.


Estamos buscando profissionais que dominem e possuam forte acuidade arquitetural, que tenha uma forte atuação hands-on em IA, domínio de DDD e design de plataformas que habilitem reuso e evolução contínua, com visão estratégica e capacidade de inovação.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para a posição de Especialista de Arquitetura de Dados & IA , que queira se desenvolver e aprender, compartilhar, colaborar e inovar, entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes.


Nessa função você vai:


Arquitetura e Plataforma

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de IA para o Banco PJ (alta escala, reuso, baixo acoplamento, personalizável), com observabilidade e tolerância a falhas de ponta a ponta.
  • Liderar decisões sobre tecnologias de IA Generativa guiado por trade-offs claros entre latência, consistência, capacidade de experimentação, custo e time-to-market.
  • Desenhar e governar soluções de IA e Agentes Generativos (aggregation, routing, orchestration, caching, personalization, feature flags, A/B) que sirvam múltiplos agentes trazendo jornadas generativas estáveis, versionamento, backward compatibility e observabilidade por domínio.
  • Direcionar o reuso dos capabilities/domain services (crm, auth, AI Models, CC, limites, PaaS), com bounded contexts bem definidos, APIs consistentes, catálogo de eventos e SDKs reutilizáveis.


Excelência de Arquitetura de Soluções

  • Tomar decisões de arquitetura usando DDD (ubiquitous language, aggregates, domain events, anticorruption layer) e arquitetura hexagonal (ports & adapters).
  • Implantar boas práticas: idempotência, backpressure, circuit breakers, retry with jitter, dead-letter queues, saga/outbox, blue/green & canary, zero-downtime migrations, security by design.
  • Garantir observabilidade abrangente (logs estruturados, tracing distribuído), SLOs por serviço e acompanhamento dos postmortems para aplicar ações de melhoria.
  • Otimizar custos na AWS (right-sizing, autoscaling, spot/ savings plans, cache e storage tiers, redução de chatter entre serviços).


Liderança Técnica

  • Definir north star architecture e roadmap evolutivo;
    alinhar múltiplos timesàs estratégias de Jornadas e Plataformas.
  • Mentorar arquitetas(os), engenheiras(os) sêniores, elevar o cdigo-foco e a qualidade técnica org-wide;
    conduzir design reviewse tech forums.
  • Colaborar com Produto e Design para equilibrar viabilidade técnica e valor de negocio, documentando trade-offs e riscos.
  • Atuar e liderar pelo exemplo, de forma hands-on no desenvolvimento de agentes, participando de revisões de codigo, testes e documentação.
  • Participar de rotações de suporte, acompanhamento, deploys fora do horário respondendo a incidentes quando necessário.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência solida e comprovada na definição e desenvolvimento de soluções de produtos digitais em ambientes complexos.
  • Profundo conhecimento em arquitetura de IA, distribuída, microserviços e tecnologias de cloud.
  • Historico comprovado na entrega de soluções para sistemas de grande escala, com foco em IA, resiliência e custo-benefício.
  • Forte domínio em linguagens backend (python);
    experiência com arquitetura e event-driven.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de CI/CD, arquiteturas de IA e integração com sistemas de alta disponibilidade.
  • Experiência em mentoria técnica, elevando o nível da arquitetura e engenharia em múltiplos times.
  • Boa comunicação para explicar trade-offs técnicos a diferentes stakeholders.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada como Executivo de Contas (Hunter/Farmer);

title: Banco De Talentos | Vagas Afirmativas | Pcds
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

Dentro desse ecossistema de soluções, a Equipo Locadora é especialista em soluções personalizadas para empresas que precisam de transporte sem complicações, oferecendo tecnologia, gestão inteligente de frota e atendimento próximo aos clientes. Com o objetivo de oferecer transporte inteligente e eficiente para empresas de diferentes portes e segmentos, sempre com foco em qualidade, confiabilidade e inovação.

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

title: International Treasury Coordinator
description:
Forno de Minas is a leading Brazilian food company with a strong heritage, recognized brands, and a growing international footprint. As the company expands its operations in the U.S. and Europe, financial governance, liquidity control, and operational excellence are critical to sustaining growth. We offer a collaborative environment with high exposure, autonomy, and direct interaction with senior leadership.


About the role


This is a highly specialized international treasury role , designed for a senior, autonomous professional.

The International Treasury Coordinator will operate independently , owning treasury, cash flow, and international banking operations across the United States, United Kingdom, and Europe .

This is not a transactional AP role .

It is a position with low payment volume but very high operational and compliance complexity , requiring strong judgment, technical depth, and end-to-end ownership.


Key responsibilities

Cash Flow & Liquidity Management

  • Build, manage, and continuously monitor short- and medium-term cash flow forecasts (including 13-week cash flow)
  • Ensure liquidity and funding availability for international operations
  • Analyze variances, assumptions, and scenarios impacting cash position

International Payments & Banking Operations

  • Execute and manage international payments across U.S. and European banking systems
  • Operate payment methods such as ACH, SWIFT, SEPA, wire transfers , and international payroll-related payments
  • Navigate banking environments without PIX or boletos
  • Manage FX transactions, payment cut-offs, bank holidays, and country-specific rules
  • Maintain strong relationships with international banks and service providers
  • Negotiate banking fees and service conditions when applicable

Accounts Payable, Receivable & Governance

  • Own the end-to-end international AP and AR flows, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timeliness
  • Partner with Accounting and local providers (e.G., Portugal accounting team) for validation and execution
  • Ensure payments align with accounting, tax, and contractual requirements
  • Apply strong governance, internal controls, and compliance standards

Cross-functional Partnership

  • Work closely with HR (international payrolls and benefits), Marketing (costs and campaigns), Accounting , FP&A , and Commercial
  • Understand accounting classifications (OPEX vs. CAPEX) and financial impacts
  • Act as a key finance partner in international operations


Profile we are looking for

  • A senior, autonomous, and highly reliable professional
  • Comfortable operating alone , without constant follow-ups
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Able to manage complex international routines with precision
  • Hands-on, detail-oriented, and resilient in a corporate governance environment
  • Strong communication skills to interact with global stakeholders


Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, Finance, or related fields
  • Fluent English (mandatory / non-negotiable)
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in Treasury or International Finance
  • Proven experience with international payments , especially in the U.S.
  • Solid knowledge of cash flow management (build, monitor, analyze)
  • Strong understanding of financial mathematics
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Experience with ERP systems (SAP and/or Datasul – TOTVS)
  • Strong understanding of corporate governance and compliance


Nice to have

  • Experience with European banking operations
  • Spanish proficiency
  • Prior exposure to multinational or international business environments


Why join Forno de Minas

  • Strategic international role with high visibility
  • Opportunity to build and structure international treasury operations
  • High level of autonomy and trust
  • Direct interaction with senior leadership
  • Exposure to global financial operations and decision-making

title: Segment Manager - Pv
description:
The Position:

As a core operator of the "Segment Penetration" strategy in the Latam region, the Segment Manager - PV will be primarily responsible for market insights, strategy formulation, competitive response, opportunity management, and capability building within the assigned segment (PV). Serving as a critical link between headquarters strategy and regional execution, this role carries the dual mission of strategic interpretation and tactical implementation, translating headquarters’ segment strategy into actionable plans, empowering country teams for execution, and fostering cross-regional collaboration to achieve synergistic outcomes.


Main activities and Responsibilities:

  • Strategy and Market Insight: Conduct in-depth analysis of policies, markets, customers, and competitors in target Latam countries. Identify segment-specific opportunities and regularly produce market analysis reports to inform segment planning and decision-making.
  • Product and Competitive Strategy: Actively participate in the formulation and review of segment product strategies, drive product optimization and standardization, and monitor strategy execution to ensure a closed-loop management process. Lead the development of segment competitive strategies, produce competitor analysis reports, and dynamically refine competitive positioning in direct sales scenarios. In channel scenarios, analyze and increase the proportion of top-tier channel partners while providing strategic support for key projects.
  • Pricing and Profitability Management: Conduct regular in-depth analysis of market pricing and competitors to support pricing strategy development. Participate in the annual product pricing strategy formulation and dynamically manage pricing execution to balance competitiveness and profitability goals.
  • Opportunity Coordination and Solution Management: Oversee segment-level opportunity management by integrating leads across countries, optimizing allocation mechanisms, and producing management reports. Promote the standardized implementation of processes at the country level. Develop and refine benchmark scenario solutions for key Latam markets, creating replicable case studies. Drive agile innovation and localization adaptation across the "Headquarters-Region-Country" three-tier structure.
  • Empowerment and Collaborative Operations: Serve as a segment expert, proactively providing strategic guidance, solution support, and project collaboration to country teams. Integrate regional resources to facilitate breakthroughs in critical projects.


Qualifications and basic Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Energy, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Proficient in English as a working language, with excellent cross-cultural communication skills.
  • Spanish knowledge is a plus


Experience and Competencies

  • Industry Experience: Experience in marketing, strategic planning, product management, or solution sales within the PV, ESS, or related industries.
  • Regional Experience: Familiarity with multiple key markets in the Latam region. Candidates with local business insights and networks are preferred.
  • Professional Expertise: Practical experience in at least three of the following areas: market insight, product/competitive strategy, pricing/opportunity management, capability building/system establishment.
  • Core Skills: Strong market analysis, data interpretation, and strategic planning abilities. Capable of independently producing high-quality strategic reports and skilled in methodology summarization and team empowerment.


Key Attributes

  • Resilience and Self-Drive: Ability to embrace change and challenges in a fast-paced international business environment, demonstrating a strong sense of responsibility and intrinsic motivation to proactively seek breakthroughs.
  • Core Qualities: Exceptional influencing and persuasion skills, teamwork spirit, customer-centric mindset, and a results-oriented approach.

  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.

  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.

  • Experience on Azure, Phyton and API development lifecycle.

title: Bess Solution Manager
description:
About Envision

Envision is a global green technology group committed to accelerating the energy transition through integrated renewable, storage, digital and hydrogen solutions.

Envision provides renewable energy system solutions to corporations, governments, and institutions worldwide, reducing the cost of renewable energy production, storage, and integration through continuous technological innovation. The company’s business spans smart wind turbines, energy storage, and green hydrogen solutions.

Today, Envision operates as an integrated net-zero technology ecosystem, combining hardware, software, and system integration capabilities across the full energy value chain.

The Group maintains a strong international presence with:

20+ R&D and operations centers

50+ manufacturing bases

80+ GW of installed wind capacity globally

10+ GWh of delivered storage capacity

Expanding green hydrogen industrial platforms

Over 50% of the international workforce


Key Platforms

Smart Wind Turbines

Envision’s smart wind platform integrates advanced sensing, digital models and digital twin technologies via the Galileo SuperSense System. With 80+ GW installed globally, Envision ranks first globally in orders and second in new installations since 2022, maintaining a leading international market position.

Energy Storage

The energy storage platform provides full-stack capabilities across battery cells, BMS, PCS, EMS and SCADA, delivering integrated end-to-end solutions. The business ranks third in China and fourth globally, with 200+ projects and 15+ GWh in orders. The ecosystem includes Envision AESC (global battery leader) and Univers (AIoT-enabled digital energy management platform).

Green Hydrogen

Envision is developing large-scale integrated green hydrogen and ammonia industrial parks, including one of the world’s largest net-zero hydrogen projects in Chifeng, Inner Mongolia (1.5 million tons planned annual capacity).

  • Design, engineer, and optimize utility-scale BESS systems and work with sales team closely to offer engineering solution to sales team and customers.

  • Conduct technical design and presentations and provide clarifications to our sales team and customers.

  • Review and submit technical tender response bundles within deadlines.
  • Follow up and analyze previous technical tender submissions to understand outcome/result from technical point of view.
  • Understand and keep up with storage market technical and engineering requirements and trends.
  • Study competitive landscape for ongoing product technical solution development.
  • Collaborate with customers and commercial teams to support them to negotiate and finalize contracts from technical perspective.


Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, Mechanical Engineering or Energy Engineering
  • Fluency in technical English

  • Practical knowledge in wind energy projects (onshore or offshore) and simulation tools (such as SCADA, WindPRO, OpenWind, etc.).

A BRQ combina especialistas, ferramentas e inteligência artificial para entregar projetos e equipes de tecnologia alinhadas aos desafios reais dos clientes, com excelência técnica e uma relação próxima e responsável. Em outras palavras: a gente entra no contexto, faz as perguntas certas, monta a combinação ideal de pessoas e tecnologia e entrega com método, clareza e consistência.

Com mais de 33 anos de história e mais de 2.500 profissionais, a BRQ está entre as maiores empresas de tecnologia do Brasil, atuando em projetos de alta complexidade e escala. Somos reconhecidos como líderes em GenAI e Inovação para grandes empresas no estudo ISG Provider Lens™.

Nosso propósito é transformar problemas complexos em progresso, com engenharia precisa, todo potencial do humano + IA e atuação próxima em cada etapa.



Atividades

  • Projetar, implementar e sustentar soluções em arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações Back-end em .NET em nível sênior.
  • Gerenciar, monitorar e otimizar infraestrutura em AWS, com uso de serviços como EC2, ECS, Lambda e S3.
  • Desenvolver integrações e fluxos assíncronos com RabbitMQ, Kafka ou outras soluções de mensageria.
  • Atuar na escalabilidade e estabilidade de sistemas distribuídos de alta performance.
  • Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais, como SQL Server e MySQL, e não relacionais, como MongoDB.
  • Garantir boas práticas de segurança, performance, resiliência e disponibilidade das aplicações.
  • Atuar em conjunto com times ágeis, utilizando CI/CD e versionamento com Git.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento Back-end com .NET.
  • Experiência sólida em ambientes escaláveis, com alto volume de transações e requisições.
  • Vivência com arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Experiência prática com AWS e seus principais serviços.
  • Conhecimento sólido em RabbitMQ ou tecnologias similares de mensageria.
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais, como SQL Server e MySQL.
  • Experiência com MongoDB ou outros bancos NoSQL.
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis, pipelines de CI/CD e versionamento com Git.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial 3 vezes por semana.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações AWS.
  • Experiência com outras plataformas de cloud, como Azure ou GCP.
  • Conhecimento em containers, especialmente Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Vivência com sistemas de alta disponibilidade e grande escalabilidade.
  • Experiência em contextos com milhões de requisições por dia e dezenas de milhões por mês.


Cultura na BRQ

Chamamos de BRQ Way o nosso jeito de cuidar das pessoas, com iniciativas de carreira e desenvolvimento, saúde e bem-estar, e comunicação e conexão. Trabalhamos com flexibilidade de acordo com o contexto do projeto (anywhere office, híbrido ou presencial) e investimos em desenvolvimento contínuo com BRQ Academy, mentoria, incentivo a certificações e programas de idiomas, entre outras frentes.

Diversidade, inclusão e liberdade fazem parte do nosso dia a dia. Temos três grupos de afinidade, chamados de Roars, para comunidade LGBTQIA+, pessoas pretas e mulheres, que criam espaços de troca e ações internas para fortalecer representatividade e pertencimento. title: Senior International Procurement, Transportantion And Logistics Analyst - English 90%
description:
About the job


The Senior Analyst, International Logistics, serves as a key strategic partner within the Raw Materials Procurement organization, responsible for ensuring the efficient, cost‑effective, and resilient movement of raw materials across the global supply chain. This role combines advanced data analytics with deep logistics expertise to design, optimize, and manage international transportation flows that support production, reduce total landed cost, and strengthen supplier and carrier performance. Serving as a boots‑on‑the‑ground contact, the Senior Analyst drives communication, negotiation, and alignment with both suppliers and transportation providers to ensure operational execution, strategic development and continuous improvement. The Senior Analyst maintains accurate inventory positions through accurate reporting of materials in the supply chain, identifies network inefficiencies, and develops improvement initiatives that enhance service, reduce risk, and support long‑term supply chain competitiveness. Through proactive analysis, cross‑functional collaboration, and continuous process optimization, this position ensures that the company’s global logistics operations are predictable, transparent, and aligned with broader supply chain and business


Scope. Santa Catarina Brazil


objectives


  • Support the efficient and cost‑effective movement of international raw materials by providing accurate data analysis, shipment visibility, and operational coordination.
  • Act as a connector between procurement, logistics, and supplier/carrier partners by translating operational realities and commercial priorities into clear insights and actions.
  • Identify issues and trends, and recommend opportunities for improvement across the international logistics network to strengthen service performance and reduce total landed cost.



What do you need?


To live in Santa Catarina mandatory English 90%

Educational Background: Bachelor of Science in Supply Chain, Business, or a related field, or

equivalent experience.

- Professional Experience: A minimum of 5 years in transportation, international logistics, or

supply chain analytics, with a proven track record of success.

- Detailed knowledge of the North American transportation industry, including LTL, truckload, rail,

warehousing, cross-border, and airfreight

- Knowledge of standard transportation import and export procedures and USDOT requirements

- Advanced experience with transportation pricing methods and practices, customs entry

processes and brokerage/clearance requirements preferred

- Demonstrated experience negotiating commercial terms for both master transportation

agreements and ad hoc projects with carriers, brokers, customs brokers, and rail lines.

- Fundamental understanding of CHEP global operations and business segments preferred

- Thorough understanding of the CHEP network pallet flows and seasonality preferred

Skills and Knowledge - Business Acumen and Problem Solving: Apply knowledge of business rules and processes to

manage organizational tasks efficiently. Utilize strong time management and problem-solving

skills to address challenges effectively



Key Responsibilities May Include:


  • Build and maintain strong relationships with domestic and international carriers, freight forwarders, and suppliers to support reliable and cost‑effective logistics operations.
  • Recommend optimal Incoterms and transportation strategies by assessing risk, cost, and supplier capabilities.
  • Monitor international shipments to maintain accurate daily visibility, escalating delays and risks and supporting timely resolution with carriers, suppliers, and internal teams.
  • Analyze logistics and inventory flow data to identify variances, inefficiencies, and potential cost‑saving or performance‑enhancing opportunities.
  • Prepare regular reporting and dashboards covering shipment status, carrier performance, costs, and inventory impacts to support decision‑making across procurement and operations.
  • Support contract and carrier management activities by gathering performance data, documenting service issues, and contributing to review discussions.
  • Maintain routing guidelines, documentation, and SOPs, helping ensure consistency and accuracy in transportation execution and compliance.
  • Assist with root‑cause investigations into service failures or cost issues, coordinating inputs across carriers, suppliers, and operational stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with planning, sourcing, operations, and transportation teams to ensure alignment on inbound flows, priorities, and risk areas.

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
The world's largest enterprises were built on an assumption about how technology works: wait for it to stabilize, evaluate what it can do, then implement. That sequence made sense when technology moved in waves with long plateaus between them.


AI doesn't have plateaus. It compounds. The models running today will be a fraction of what exists in six months, and every pause gives back what came before.


We built Tela to be the reference for enterprise AI, meaning: embedded teams and a platform that live at the frontier, inside the enterprises that can't afford to stop moving. We call this Adoption in Motion (AIM) : continuous, never a project with an end date. Two years in, we're embedded inside leaders across financial services, energy, telecom, among others.


We're Looking For

A Deployment Strategist to make AIM real inside these partners.

You'll work shoulder to shoulder with C-level executives on the hardest problems inside a large enterprise. The kind of work that moves the economics of the business.

You'll sit where three worlds meet: the frontier of AI, the inside of a large enterprise, and Tela's solution engineers. Your job is to keep the three in sync so motion never stops.

This role didn't exist in the enterprise world before AI started compounding. It exists now because nothing else fits. Vendors leave. Consultancies run projects. Internal teams move in planning cycles. AIM never ends — and a Deployment Strategist is the person who keeps it alive.


Your day-to-day

  • Own a partner relationship end to end: from discovery, through deployment, into continuous adoption.
  • Turn hard business problems into AI-native solutions alongside our solution engineers.
  • Find the highest-leverage opportunities inside a partner's operations and sequence them into a roadmap that compounds.
  • Make trade-offs visible to executives so they can decide fast, with real information.
  • Measure impact in the partner's own language: revenue, cost, speed, risk.
  • Lead internal initiatives at Tela that shape where our platform and playbook go next.


Bonus Points For

  • Experience in strategic consulting or product management, with exposure to problem-solving, structured analysis, and executive-level projects
  • Background in technology-driven projects or a strong interest in AI platforms, workflow automation, and adjacent systems
  • Experience navigating complex organizations, stakeholders, and decision-making processes


You'll Excel Here If You...

Tela is a high-agency environment. Five principles you'll feel from day one:

  • Ownership is total. If it's yours, it's yours. Outcomes included.
  • Overdelivery through thinking : the fastest path is rarely the obvious one. Push back on work that isn't worth the time, and find the better version of it.
  • Candor runs both ways. We'll tell you straight when you're great and when you're not. You're expected to do the same.
  • Assume intent. When something's breaking, the first question is "how do I help?"
  • Embrace ambiguity : move forward without perfect information, structuring problems and paths to solutions as you go.
  • Purpose over momentum. We don't do things just because they're in front of us.


Inside Tela, everyone is a chef. A form of respect that recognizes every role as essential to the final result, and a reminder that the standard we hold ourselves to is a 3-Michelin-star experience.


What you'll get

  • Market leading compensation
  • Equity upside – Grow with the company you help build
  • Global product exposure – Your work will impact clients worldwide
  • PTO – Recharge when you need it
  • Direct access to founders – Real influence over our roadmap


Enterprise AI is being defined right now. We're defining it. If that sits right, talk to us.
